title: instrument token-level SLOs, reduce alert noise, and add trace annotations for cache/path breakdowns
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Introduce token-level SLO instrumentation and tuned alert rules to reduce noise; add Grafana dashboards for token cost/latency breakdowns; backfill tracing for cache hit/miss and routing path. Rollout via canary.
description: Motivation: customers and SREs have asked for finer-grained SLOs that map directly to token economics and user-perceived latency while reducing alert fatigue from our previous coarse rules. This PR introduces token-level metrics, new distributed trace annotations, dashboard panels, and a revised alerting strategy that migrates from static P99-only alerts to composite SLOs + dynamic noise filters. Summary of changes: added histogram metrics for token-latency and token-count-per-request; instrumented KV cache and routing spans with tags (cache_hit, model_variant, route_type) so traces can be sliced by these dimensions; added a token-cost breakdown metric that multiplies tokens with per-model unit cost to produce a per-request cost gauge; created Grafana dashboards with templated variables (model, region, route) and panels for p50/p90/p95/p99 token-latency, tokens-per-request distribution, and cost-per-request heatmaps; introduced SLO rules that combine latency and cost health (e.g., SLO: 99% of requests <= 350ms tail OR cost regression <= +10% on rolling 24h) and an alert noise reduction layer using alert-aggregation-window and mute-on-incident logic; updated runbooks with triage steps and degradation thresholds. Checklist: [x] Add metrics + Instrumentation | [x] Add trace tags and span fixes | [x] Dashboards and panels | [x] New alert rules + unit tests for alert generation logic | [x] Update runbook + docs | [x] Canary pipeline and synthetic test updated | [x] Post-merge migration to backfill historical token-cost via offline job. Testing and validation: unit tests (metrics serialization, alert rule evaluation) and integration tests (simulated requests exercising cache hit/miss, model routing) included. Ran observability canary in staging for 48 hours with synthetic load using scripts/perf/synth_traffic.py; no regressions in serving latency and alerts triggered only for injected fault cases. Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main 2) Deploy canary (5% traffic) and monitor token SLO dashboard for 4h 3) If canary stable, escalate to 25% then 100% over 2 hours 4) Run backfill job to populate token-cost historic metrics for dashboards. Backwards compatibility: all added metrics are additive; no change to existing metric names used by alerting outside this PR. Configuration: new feature flags to enable token-cost metric emission per-tenant. Security/privacy: token-cost is computed from token counts and model unit prices only; no user PII is emitted. Related work: follow-up will add tenant-level budget alerts and per-route throttling suggestions (ENG-3012).

review_thread: 2025-10-29 Carlos Mendes: Please avoid adding high-cardinality tags directly to metrics; prefer span tags and derived aggregates. -> Addressed: moved raw model_variant to traces and emit model_family aggregates for metrics.

2025-10-31 Aria Gupta: Tests failing intermittently in CI (integration) — looks like race in synth traffic teardown. -> Fixed: introduced proper wait/teardown and retried flakey assertion; re-ran CI.
2025-11-02 Priya Nair: Response to review comments, added docs and adjusted thresholds to be region-aware (EU vs US baseline).

notes: This PR intentionally leaves per-tenant cost export behind a feature flag; follow-up will add billing export. The token-cost backfill job is scheduled as a post-merge cron. Monitor dashboards for first 72h after full rollout.
